from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as presented (e.g., '《判决文书1》')")
    dispute_type: str = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action or dispute type mentioned in the text (e.g., '公司解散纠纷', '侵害实用新型专利权纠纷')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentRecord]
